item.title: Savarkar: Echoes from a Forgotten Past, 1883–1924: A Review
item.description: Image Courtesy: Penguin India Vinayak Damodar Savarkar is among the most debated figures in India’s freedom movement, evoking both admiration and criticism. item.title: Why Hindus Must Relearn the Art of Knowing Themselves — and Their Enemies (A Wake-Up Call for Hindu Civilization)
item.description: In Swayambodha and Shatrubodha: Hindu View of Self and the World, scholar-thinker Pankaj Saxena presents a profound civilizational analysis of Hindu selfhood and its adversaries. Moving beyond politics and polemics, the book explores how true decolonization must begin within — through swayambodha (knowledge of the Self) and shatrubodha (awareness of hostile forces).
